summary: Vehicle setup step called from VehgenScnFileLoader: looks up the driver number in a named-entry format list using strings from the vehicle record and stores the result in field 0x489C (DriverID). When the first lookup returns negative it falls back to a lookup derived from a vehicle-array entry computed as dword_8AC394 + 1060 * field 0x4898, substituting byte_5EA438 as the name list when the entry name pointer is empty. It then scans the same format list against a long-description string and stores the resulting index in field 0x48A0, which is also returned.

If the stored lookup result in field this+18588 (0x489C) is negative (not found), take the fallback path.
Compute the vehicle-array entry address as dword_8AC394 + 1060 * field this+18584 (0x4898).
If the computed vehicle-array entry address is non-zero, continue the fallback lookup.
Read the entry name pointer at the entry; if the dword at the entry is zero, substitute v4 = byte_5EA438 as the name list.
NamedEntryLookupInFormatList(&dword_5EA5E8, name at entry+188, name list v4): store its result into field this+18588 (0x489C), overwriting the failed lookup.
